Administration
The Administration Office entails notary services, county board administrator, housing abatement and loan funding.
Assessor
The Assessor's Office offers property valuations, homesteading, and special programs.
Attorney's Office
The Attorney's Office offers criminal charges/sentencing, and victim services.
Auditor / Treasurer
Gather more information about the Auditor/Treasurer's Office and the services they provide, including property tax information, birth and death certificates, marriage licenses and certified copies, election and voter information, delinquent taxes and property tax forfeitures, notary services, and various licenses.
Correctional Services
Get information about the Correctional Services Department.
Court Administration
Access information about the Court Administration.
Emergency Management
Mower County Emergency Management is responsible for the development of community-based plans and programs to maintain a state of readiness to meet natural, man-made and technological disasters on local and county-wide bases.
Environmental Services
Administers land use permits consistent with the County Ordinance and Comprehensive Plan including Zoning Permit, Conditional Use Permit, Variances and other land use or zoning projects; also includes Environmental Services such as Individual Sewage Treatment Systems, Feedlots, and Recycling and Household Hazardous Waste Services.
Extension Office
Review information about the University of Minnesota Extension Office.
Finance
View more information about the Finance Department of Mower County.
GIS - Online Mapping
Find out more about the Geographic Information Systems (GIS) services provided in Mower County.
Health & Human Services
Mower County Health and Human Services administers and implements County, State, and federal laws, regulations, mandates and ordinances involving the promotion of healthy communities as well as prevention, early intervention, protection and self-sufficiency for children, families and adults.
Human Resources
The Department of Human Resources provides programs and services in support of a high-performing workforce and organizational excellence. Human Resources services include recruitment and employment, compensation and benefits, and wellness programs.
Highway
The Public Works Department oversees County Engineering, Roadway andEquipment Maintenance, and Environmental Services which includes Planning and Zoning, Septic Systems, Solid Waste, Feedlots, and Recycling & Household Hazardous Waste.
Recorders Office
The Mower County Recorder/Registrar of Titles is the custodian of all legal records accepted and recorded/filed in Mower County.
Recycling & Household Hazardous Waste
Get information about recycling and household hazardous waste.
Sheriffs Office
The Sheriff's Office maintains the County Jail, provides security for the County Courts, and serves various legal papers throughout the county.
Veterans Services Office
Find contact information for the Veterans Services Office.
